summary: Speed up the local/CI gate (make check: 10.5m -> ~2m warm)
description:
**As** a developer, **I want** `make check` to finish in ~2 minutes on a warm cache (local and CI) **so that** the gate stays cheap enough to run on every change.

Measured on CI run 29205106777 (green, 2026-07-12): total 10m32s — smoke `compose up --build` 5m35 (tests themselves <1s), `pnpm install` 2m05 (no store cache), lint-go 2m15 (8 serial cold golangci-lint runs). Actual test+build work: ~40s.

**Priority:** P1

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Service Dockerfiles use BuildKit cache mounts (go mod + go build cache); a code-only change does not re-download modules or rebuild unchanged layers
- [ ] CI reuses Docker layer cache across runs (gha cache or equivalent); warm-cache smoke stage well under 2m
- [ ] pnpm store cached in CI (`setup-node` with `cache: pnpm`); deps stage seconds on warm cache
- [ ] lint-go parallelized or single-run (go.work or `make -j`); golangci-lint cache persisted in CI
- [ ] Redundant `go vet -tags smoke` removed from build-go (golangci-lint already runs govet)
- [ ] Node 20 deprecation warning gone: bump `pnpm/action-setup` (and any other actions pinned to node20 runtimes) to current major
- [ ] Gate semantics unchanged: same checks, same failure behavior; gate-selftest still passes; `make check` still green from a clean clone
- [ ] Warm/cold timings documented in docs (before/after table)

Quality gates: `make check` green; gate-selftest green; no UI/money paths touched.

objective.note: Gate is 10.5m; ~9.5m is cache/serialization waste, measured from CI logs

scope.note: In: Makefile, service Dockerfiles, check.yaml caching, action bumps. Out: changing what the gate checks, test changes, runtime code

uncertainties.note: Exact gha-cache wiring for compose builds (bake vs build-push-action) and pnpm/action-setup current major — both resolvable by reading docs during Planning, no redesign risk

dependencies.note: None — TKT-25 merged; no open blockers

approach.note: BuildKit cache mounts + CI layer cache; pnpm store cache; parallel/single lint; drop redundant vet; action bumps

first_slice.note: Single slice: all changes are to the gate itself and land in one PR, verified by gate-selftest + timings

success.note: COS: warm gate ~2m CI+local, semantics unchanged, node20 warning gone, timings documented

binding.rule: Five Go services behind a gateway, event bus, Docker Compose only.
make check mirrors CI exactly (config.code.localGate); gate-selftest proves the gate fails on seeded errors.

reference.summary: CI timing breakdown (run 29205106777): smoke 5m35 / pnpm install 2m05 / lint-go 2m15 / test+build ~40s
Node 20 deprecation on GH runners (pnpm/action-setup@v4 warning in gate-selftest)
